container_boiler_page.desc_body: Automated block-modular boiler house with full factory readiness. Equipped for operation on both natural gas and diesel fuel in full compliance with SP 'Boiler Installations' and SP 'Gas Distribution Systems' on a 'plug & play' principle. The delivery package includes roof-mounted chimneys, substantially reducing structural costs compared to freestanding chimneys. Control is performed via robust relay schemes and OVEN mini-controllers requiring no custom programming, ensuring high reliability for all actuators. Delivery agreement covers comprehensive commissioning works and direct manufacturer support during official commissioning into commercial operation.
container_boiler_page.pack1: Hot water firetube boiler, two-pass // 'Teplofor Lex V2 – D400'
container_boiler_page.pack2: Forced-draft burner, modulating regulation // 'Riello RS 50 Gas/Diesel'
container_boiler_page.pack3: Plate heat exchangers demountable ET-007s, ET-004s // NPO 'ETRA'
container_boiler_page.pack4: Pumping equipment (boiler circuit, heating loop, feed pumps) // 'CNP'
container_boiler_page.pack5: Membrane expansion tank for heating & potable water supply // 'Wester'
container_boiler_page.pack10: Fiscal metering stations for gas, thermal and electric energy
container_boiler_page.extra1_desc: We perform site integration design of the boiler house into the Customer's master site plan, including onsite gas, heat, power, water supply and sewage networks with positive expert review clearance.
container_boiler_page.extra2_desc: We develop outdoor gas supply engineering from the connection tie-in point at the gas supply source to the boiler room in strict accordance with the gas distributor's technical conditions, securing all approvals.
container_boiler_page.extra3_desc: We execute full construction and installation works for onsite utility networks (gas, heating, electricity, water supply, sewage) with final commissioning handover.
container_boiler_page.extra4_desc: We compile a complete as-built documentation package for the completed facility and handle formal inspection approval before supervisory authorities: gas supplier, Rostekhnadzor.

container_boiler_page.about_p1: Engineering company Energy Plus has specialized for over twenty years in the design and construction of gas boiler plants, including block-modular, built-in, attached, roof-mounted, and standalone boiler rooms, as well as onsite and offsite gas transmission pipelines.
container_boiler_page.about_p2: Our company delivers a full turnkey cycle in thermal power generation: from obtaining statutory baseline approvals to commissioning boiler houses into commercial operation. We operate our own design bureau and manufacturing facility, enabling us to deliver modular boiler houses with superior cost-effectiveness and reliability.
